captured_from.pattern_description: The agent autonomously identified a critical state machine desync from recent signal rejections, diagnosed the root cause (missing broker reconciliation), implemented a 76-line fix with 11 tests, and verified 83/83 pass — all in under 10 minutes. This 'observe anomaly → diagnose → fix → test → verify' pattern in free-will blocks is highly effective and should be captured as a reusable skill for autonomous exploration shifts.
